notes: `הֲ` takes the fronted *Shall* under rule 17; `מָה` in JOB.40.4 is the contrasting case where the interrogative has an English word of its own and the auxiliary stays with the verb.

The *with* of *argueth with God* is the English verb's valency preposition for the bare object `אֱלוֹהַּ` (rule 44), not anything the noun licenses; the substantival units head on their lexeme-bearing words under rule 46.
